product.title: Cortech Summit Side Table - Molded Base with Laminate Top - Models 342 & 343
product.body_html:
The Cortech 342 or 343 Summit Side Table pairs calming design with durable construction for behavioral health and other high-use secure environments. Because of its simple, residential feel, the table fits naturally in lounges, dayrooms, waiting areas, and patient spaces to support a therapeutic environment.

  • Molded polyethylene base is inherently antimicrobial and easy to clean
  • The base is one piece, removing seams and joints that could be tampered with
  • High-pressure laminate top resists moisture and impact, giving staff a dependable surface that cleans easily and performs well over time
  • Options:
    • Model 342 - Low Table with Small Delta Top
    • Model 343 - Low Table with Mid-Size Delta Top
    • Models 342S and 343S have a ballast door that secures with tamper-resistant screws and can be used to add sandbags on-site (loose sand not recommended)
    • Factory weighting available
  • Lifetime Warranty on base; 5-Year Warranty on top
  • Made in the USA to ISO Quality Standards
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, Tide

Summit side table coordinate with other Summit seating and tables, allowing facilities to create cohesive, human-centered environments. Its cleanability, strength, and calming design make it a dependable choice for spaces that support healing and safety.

About Cortech Summit Furniture:
The Cortech Summit Series intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Cortech Summit Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
